FC i = The total number of fill operations over the period p for the valve-hose combination Ci. EF Ci = The emission factor for the valve-hose combination Ci. n=The number of different valve-hose combinations C used during the period p. ( h ) If the mass of insulating gas j disbursed to customers in new equipment or cylinders over the period p is determined by using the nameplate capacity, or by using the nameplate capacity of the equipment and calculating the partial shipping charge, use the methods in either paragraph (h)(1) or (2) of this section. ( 1 ) Determine the equipment's actual nameplate capacity, by measuring the nameplate capacities of a representative sample of each make and model and calculating the mean value for each make and model as specified at § 98.454(f) . ( 2 ) If equipment is shipped with a partial charge, calculate the partial shipping charge by multiplying the nameplate capacity of the equipment by the ratio of the densities of the partial charge to the full charge.
